raw_response.overall_narrative_summary: No risk-of-bias appraisal could be conducted because the retrieved cached PDF is an incomplete 2-page publisher preview (pp. 251–252 of pp. 251–277). Only the header, abstract, keywords, and opening four paragraphs of Section 1 (Introduction) are available before the text truncates mid-sentence at the bottom of page 252. Although the abstract and opening introduction describe a focus on domestic water supply indicators (quantity, quality, accessibility, and reliability), water inequity, and the governance role of informal local institutions (dorbar shnong) in non-municipal localities of Shillong, India, pages 253–277—which contain the Methods, sampling/recruitment procedures, measurement operationalization, analytical strategy, and Results—are completely absent. In accordance with blinding and non-guessing rules, study design, appraisal tool selection, overall rating, and all seven cross-tool bias domains are recorded as cannot_tell.
